photo.hint: Take one photo of the room. You can always use the tap list below instead.
photo.noFaceApi: Keep people out of the photo.
photo.consent.title: Before you scan a photo
photo.consent.gemini: This sends your photo to Google's Gemini to spot hazards. It is not saved by GrowSafe. Keep people out of the photo. Free AI services may use submitted content to improve their products; do not send photos with children or personal documents.
photo.consent.anthropic: This sends your photo to Anthropic's Claude to spot hazards. It is not saved by GrowSafe. Keep people out of the photo. Free AI services may use submitted content to improve their products; do not send photos with children or personal documents.
photo.consent.generic: This sends your photo to a hosted AI service (Google's Gemini or Anthropic's Claude) to spot hazards. It is not saved by GrowSafe. Keep people out of the photo. Free AI services may use submitted content to improve their products; do not send photos with children or personal documents.
photo.review.title: What we spotted
photo.review.hint: Untick anything that is wrong before you add it.
photo.review.none: No hazards detected in this photo. That does not mean the room is safe. Use the tap list below to check the rest.
photo.applied: Added to the tap list below. Check it, then add to your plan.
photo.sampleNote: Sample result: example findings, not from your room.
photo.issue.dark: That photo is too dark. Retake it with the lights on.
photo.issue.blurry: That photo is too blurry. Retake it and hold still.
photo.issue.face: Keep people out of the photo. That photo was discarded. Retake it.
photo.issue.unreadable: We could not read that photo. Retake it, or use the tap list.
photo.fail.offline: Could not reach the photo service. Use the tap list below.
photo.fail.timeout: The photo service took too long. Use the tap list below.
photo.fail.unavailable: Photo scan is not available right now. Use the tap list below.
photo.fail.rate_limited: Too many scans from this device for now. Use the tap list below.
photo.fail.daily_cap: The free scans for today are used up. Use the tap list below.
photo.fail.provider_error: The photo service had a problem. Use the tap list below.
photo.fail.bad_output: We could not make sense of the answer. Use the tap list below.
